name: Clean
oneliner: Polished voice and a quiet room-tone bed. Nothing you'd notice, just better.
description: Your voice gets cleaned up and evened out, with a soft whoosh on jump cuts. No hits, no pops.
prompt: Sound pass, preset clean. Set EDL to the EDL the draft was rendered from ($W/edl.story.json after a story pass, else $W/edl.json). Run it on the finished picture (after captions, before QA): python3 scripts/rr.py run -- python3 engines/sound.py "$W/captioned.mp4" --out "$W/sound.mp4" --edl "$EDL" --captions "$W/draft.words.json" --preset clean. It polishes the voice (highpass 80 Hz, de-esser, 3:1 compression at -18 dB), lays a pink room-tone bed at about -45 LUFS so cuts never drop to digital silence, puts one short whoosh at -14 dB under the voice on each internal cut and one soft click at the first caption, then normalises to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP with the video stream copied. If M2 is in the mix, these whooshes replace M2's; never add both. Do NOT add music, risers or impacts with this card, and do NOT run a second S card on the same edit.
